messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] Priority P1 — Dedicated pool saturation for tenant kestrelbio-prod. GPU utilization 100% across pool kestrelbio-prod (8/8 GPUs used), queue latency spiking to 6s. Notifying #incidents and paging on-call.
elliot (oncall): I’m on it — pulling metrics. ETA 5.
elliot (oncall): @samir can you join? looks like a single tenant is hogging the pool.
samir (sre): joining. checking request traces and active allocations.
samir (sre): Allocation list shows long-running job id job-9a7c (owner: @kestrelbio-training) holding 5 GPUs (pinned) — started ~22h ago. Other smaller inference workers taking rest.
maya (infra): autoscaler hasn't fired — max_nodes configured = 2, pool currently at max. There is burst policy disabled for this tenant.
elliot (oncall): customer = KestrelBio (enterprise dedicated). They have reserved capacity but not burst. Do we have contractual allowance to burst? @ana (cust-eng) can you confirm SLA?
ana (cust-eng): KestrelBio CSM here — their contract: reserved 8 GPUs, burst to shared spare capacity requires approval. They requested occasional burst historically but never enabled. I can ping their engineering lead.
kevin (platform): quick mitigation options: 1) enable temp burst into shared spare pool (riskier for other tenants), 2) evict/kill training job (customer impact), 3) throttle long-running job via scheduler (reduce GPUs), 4) failover some inference requests to smaller model variant.
elliot (oncall): Need decision within 10m. Current customer impact: only KestrelBio affected (their API requests queue up), other dedicated tenants unaffected. But shared pool will be impacted if we burst.
samir (sre): we can do a soft throttle: reduce job-9a7c from 5->2 GPUs with scheduler command, might degrade their training throughput but keep their inference stable. Do we have a live control plane command?
maya (infra): yes — internal command available: `rci admin adjust-allocation --tenant kestrelbio-prod --alloc job-9a7c --gpus 2 --reason "auto-mitigation-incident-2523456789"` (requires platform-admin role). It will signal the job to release GPUs gracefully.
elliot (oncall): If we do that, need exec approval. @kevin can you perform or give quick goto?
kevin (platform): I can run, but need CSM sign-off because it's customer-owned job. @ana take a quick ack?
ana (cust-eng): I pinged KestrelBio eng lead on call and they responded: "If it keeps our inference online, reduce training to 2 GPUs for 6 hours, please." They asked for notifications when done.
elliot (oncall): ok proceed with scheduler throttle. @kevin please run the command and record timestamps. We'll keep burst disabled.
kevin (platform): running now.
kevin (platform): ```
# executing
rci admin adjust-allocation --tenant kestrelbio-prod --alloc job-9a7c --gpus 2 --reason "mitigation-2523456789"
# result: job signalled, 3 GPUs released, allocation now 2 GPUs
```
samir (sre): metrics: released GPUs freeing 3/8 slots, utilization now 62% across pool, queue latency dropping to 1.3s.
elliot (oncall): great. mark mitigation: throttle job-9a7c -> 2 GPUs, duration requested 6h. Create follow-up runbook note.
nana (cust-eng): I'll file a customer notification to KestrelBio: note we throttled your training job per your request to restore inference latency; we'll revert after 6h or earlier by request.
maya (infra): Creating temporary quota flag: `tenant_kestrelbio_prod.burst_enabled = false` (explicit). Leaving autoscaler unchanged.
samir (sre): Post-action checklist: 1) monitor for flapping, 2) confirm sched reclaim logs, 3) verify no collateral impact on shared spare pool — none so far.
elliot (oncall): Handing off to samir (sre) for monitoring and to ana for customer comms. I’m going offline in 30m but will be available for escalation.
samir (sre): I'll watch for 1h. If another peak, we consider controlled burst with ops approval (document risk and notify other tenants).
nana (cust-eng): Noted. I'll follow up with CSM and KestrelBio for retrospective and ask them to schedule non-critical training runs off-peak.
kevin (platform): logging action in incident tracker: incident-2523456789, mitigation=throttle job, admin_cmd=rci admin adjust-allocation, initiated_by=kevin.
elliot (oncall): closing pager for now — incident moving to monitoring. If SLOs breach again, page P1. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident status updated to "mitigated (throttled)" by kevin. Monitoring mode enabled.
